# IMR Press

> A scholarly publishing platform specializing in peer-reviewed medical and scientific journals with a focus on obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive health.

IMR Press publishes high-impact medical journals including Clinical and Experimental Obstetrics & Gynecology, featuring international editorial boards composed of leading researchers and clinicians from prestigious institutions worldwide.

- Clinical and Experimental Obstetrics & Gynecology

- Journal Leadership
- Reproductive Endocrinology
- Obstetrics and Gynecology

## Journal Leadership

- [Clinical and Experimental Obstetrics & Gynecology Editorial Board](https://www.imrpress.com/journal/ceog/editorial-board): Editorial board for Clinical and Experimental Obstetrics & Gynecology journal, featuring international leadership in obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive endocrinology
